$house-style: Em dashes are this repository's house style, so no-em-dash is downgraded from the default error to warn. The prose uses them for appositive asides in every outward surface (README, docs/RELEASING.md, docs/COMMAND-DISCLOSURE.md, CHANGELOG.md) - over 1,200 of them - and rewriting that many would replace the voice the docs are written in rather than remove a tell. The rule stays on at warn instead of off so a file that suddenly accumulates them is still visible in a run.
$allow-vocabulary: harness is kept at warn rather than banned outright: it is a term of art here for the Electron E2E harness and the unit test harness (audits/2026-05-31-ground-truth-audit.md, REMAINING-WORK.md ATR-047). The words that were genuine tells - landscape (docs/archive) and highest-leverage (audits/2026-07-11) - were rewritten instead.
$severities: banned-vocabulary stays at its default warn rather than being escalated to error, so a future use of a domain term does not fail a build.
